name: My puppy:  Fox
summary: Bring a playful Red Fox into your mixed reality world! Clever and full of curiosity, this little friend loves attention and fun. Feed it sweet biscuits or tender chicken legs, and it’ll wag its fluffy tail in delight. Toss a ball or toy bone to see it dart around with quick, graceful moves. When it curls up near you, reach out to gently stroke its soft head or rub its belly—it will chirp happily and close its eyes.
